sections.heading: How Dubai’s Desert Climate Affects Interior Cleanliness

Even when the windows are closed, tiny particles slip through door seals and ventilation ducts, settling on seats, carpets, and dashboards. Over time, this gritty layer behaves like an abrasive, wearing down leather stitching and dulling fabric fibres. Because the particles are so fine, a simple vacuum often leaves a visible residue, prompting many owners to opt for a professional deep clean. At Al Haya Villa Deep Cleaning we see this pattern repeat across all vehicle classes, which is why the car interior cleaning price Dubai includes a thorough extraction step to lift embedded sand before any conditioning is applied.

Heat‑induced fading & cracking
Dubai’s summer temperatures regularly exceed 45 °C (113 °F), and the sun’s UV rays are intense. Prolonged exposure can cause leather seats to lose their natural oils, resulting in cracking, while fabric upholstery may fade or become brittle. Plastic trim and dashboard surfaces can turn yellow or develop a powdery surface film. These climate‑related degradations increase the amount of work required during a luxury car interior cleaning Dubai session, as we must treat each material with specific protectants and sometimes perform spot repairs. This extra labour is reflected in the car interior deep cleaning price for premium finishes.

Air‑condition vent sanitization
